newsitem.title: USA: FSI Intl sees Q2 sales below Q1.
newsitem.headline: FSI Intl sees Q2 sales below Q1.

text.p: FSI International Inc said Monday it expect sales in the fiscal second quarter to be below those of the first quarter.
FSI today reported first quarter (ended November 30) earnings of $0.18 a share on sales of $66.99 million, compared to $0.33 a share on sales of $70.34 million a year earlier.
FSI said it continues to forecast an overall sales decline of eight to 12 percent in fiscal 1997, from $304 million in fiscal 1996.
In a press release, the company said industry conditions continue to be difficult, but it recently has seen a reduction in order cancellations and customer-requested delays.
It said it believes it could see an improvement in orders by the third quarter if personal computer demand remains strong and the worldwide economy continues to grow at a modest rate.
